prompt.alinti: Be honest: do I have a real memory layer, or are you just reading my text files? Can you (1) remember me in a brand-new chat without me re-pasting anything, (2) search my notes by meaning not keywords, and (3) connect facts across them? If not — what am I actually using right now? (would installing cognee help me?)

yontem.ne: AI ajanlarına kalıcı hafıza katmanı eklemek için açık kaynaklı bir platform kullanımı
yontem.alinti: Instead, give your AI an actual memory layer, like Cogni. It's open source with over 20,000 stars on GitHub

yazi: Cognee: open-source AI memory platform for agents (v1.2.1), 22.5k stars on GitHub
